unit.why: A kabbalistic teaching that the first twelve days of Nisan stand for the twelve months leads into a short anecdote: the holy rabbi Mahari"tz foretold each month by holy spirit, and in the year he died in Av he wrote only up to Av.

stories.end_quote: רק עד מנחם והענין הוא בפרסום
stories.summary_en: Each of the first twelve days of Nisan corresponds to a month of the year. The rebbe Mahari"tz used to write by holy spirit what each month would bring, and in the year he died in Av he wrote only until Av, foreshadowing his death.

quotes: היה כותב ברוח קדשו בכל יום מה יהיה בכל חודש
tags.why: He foretold the events of each month
